items.headline: Hormuz me chauthe tanker me aag
items.detail: Iran ki nausena ne kaha pichhle 24 ghante me chautha tanker Hormuz ke paas samudri mine se takrakar jal utha; UKMTO ne Oman ke paas ek aur tanker par hamle ki bhi khabar di, uska amla surakshit hai.
items.exam_angle: Hormuz, tel vyapar, samudri suraksha — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Russia ne Kyiv ke do pulon par hamla kiya
items.detail: Mayor Klitschko ke mutabik der raat Dnipro nadi ke uttari aur dakshini pulon par hamle hue, shahar ke kuchh hisson me pani-bijli band; Zelenskyy ne pehle hi bade hamle ki chetavni di thi.
items.exam_angle: Russia-Ukraine yuddh, Kyiv — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: WHO: dawai-pratirodh se 2050 tak 3.9 crore maut
items.detail: WHO ne chetavni di ki antimicrobial resistance aadhunik chikitsa ke liye khatra hai; 2021 me isse 10 lakh se zyada mautein seedhe taur par hui thin, aur 2030 ke lakshya se ladai peechhe hai.
items.exam_angle: AMR, WHO, swasthya — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Trump-Xi-Putin ki pehli trilateral baithak 19 November ko
items.detail: China ne pushti ki teeno neta APEC ke dauraan Shenzhen mein milenge; parmanu hathiyar katauti aur Iran par baat hogi, Ukraine par baat ki ummeed nahi.
items.exam_angle: Teen parmanu shaktiyon ki pehli trilateral baithak — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Europe me holiday season par US aatank chetavni
items.detail: US dutavas ne kaha bheed-bhaad wale bazaar, transport hub aur pooja sthalon par hamle ka khatra hai; nagrikon ko satark rehne aur STEP me register karne ko kaha.
items.exam_angle: US travel advisory aur Europe suraksha — IR ke liye upyogi.

items.headline: America ke bade banks ki seva thap
items.detail: Chase, Bank of America aur Wells Fargo ki online seva me dikkat aayi; JPMorgan ne software bug ko wajah bataya aur cyber hamle se inkar kiya, khate aur rakam surakshit bataye.
items.exam_angle: Banking system, digital payment aur cyber-suraksha — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Crimean Bridge par doosri baar hamla
items.detail: 24 ghante me doosri baar Kerch Bridge par hamla hua; Crimea ke governor ne traffic band karne ki pushti ki, nuksan ki matra abhi saaf nahi hai.
items.exam_angle: Kerch Bridge — Russia-Crimea supply route, UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.
